info.title: CSG Learning API — migrated transport contracts

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: open: pending and reviewing, oldest first. resolved: actioned and dismissed, most recently resolved first. Without it: the 200 most recent reports.

get.summary: Read a lesson for the block editor (staff; saving needs lesson editing access)

put.summary: Save every block of a lesson in one transaction (staff; saving needs lesson editing access)
put.description: Atomic: lesson settings, blocks in order, removals and objective alignments commit together. Block ids are kept on reorder. 409 with code stale_editor when base_updated_at is not the current version; 422 with code learner_data, confirm_watch_reset or blocks_mismatch when a save would lose learner work or doesn't list every block, or retry when it collided with learner writes and saved nothing.

get.summary: Instructors assigned to a cohort, with their lesson editing access (admins)

post.summary: Assign an instructor to a cohort (admins)

delete.summary: Remove an instructor from a cohort, with any lesson editing access there (admins)

patch.summary: Give or remove an instructor's lesson editing access for this cohort (admins)
patch.description: Records lesson_editing_granted or lesson_editing_revoked in activity events. Setting the current value again changes nothing.

post.summary: Move a lesson to a day and place in any module of its curriculum (admins)
post.description: The lesson keeps its id, so learner data stays attached. dry_run returns the impact only. expected_impact is the impact the person confirmed from a dry run: the move recomputes it under its locks and is refused with code impact_changed (and the new impact) when it differs. 409 stale_editor when base_updated_at isn't current; 422 with code module_mismatch, release_day, archived, learner_access (learners with work couldn't open the lesson at its new place today, by the lesson page's access rule), impact_changed, or retry.

expected_impact.description: The impact the person confirmed from a dry run of these same parameters.

post.summary: Copy a lesson and its blocks as new rows, archived, after the original (admins)
post.description: No learner data is copied; the copy's blocks are new rows.

get.summary: Search records the current viewer can open; no global counts

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Two characters minimum; simple full-text prefix matching.

get.summary: List slim summaries of cohorts accessible to the signed-in user

200.description: Accessible cohort summaries; excludes student lists and management details.

get.summary: Preview Make a copy for this cohort (admins, and instructors with editing access for the cohort)
get.description: Dry run: the counts the copy would create and move, the other cohorts that keep the shared curriculum, and blockers (can_copy is false while any remain). 403 with code not_allowed for staff who can't copy for this cohort.

parameters.name: source_curriculum_id
parameters.description: The curriculum the cohort uses now, as the editor saw it.

post.summary: Make a copy for this cohort
post.description: Copies the shared curriculum, switches the cohort to the copy and moves the cohort's learner data (progress, submissions, release dates and every other content reference) to the copy's ids in one transaction. Learner progress and the cohort's submission windows are compared before and after; any difference rolls back (422 verification_failed). Old ids keep resolving for the cohort's learners. 201 when copied; 200 with already_copied when an earlier request made it, so a client that timed out can repeat the request and gets the same copy. 409 busy when the copy waited more than 5 s on someone else's lock or a statement ran past 30 s (nothing was copied; repeat the request); 409 content_moved when the cohort no longer uses source_curriculum_id (reload). 403 not_allowed; 422 with code copy_not_needed, source_missing, source_archived, copied_before, unassigned_learner_work, media_missing, media_changed, verification_failed or invalid.

409.description: Nothing was copied: busy (repeat the request in a moment) or content_moved (the cohort no longer uses this curriculum; reload).

get.summary: One page of the Grading workbench's queue (staff)
get.description: Attempts in the viewer's scope (the cohort named, or every cohort they teach; every cohort for an admin), filtered and counted on the server. Rows carry no answer text. Old module and lesson ids from before a cohort's copy resolve to the copy's when cohort_id is given.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: ungraded (default): latest attempts with no grade. redo: latest attempts sent back. all: every attempt.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: oldest (default) or newest first; ids break ties.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based; past the end serves the last page.

parameters.name: focus_id
parameters.description: Serve the page that holds this submission, when it is in the list.
